remarks: Step into style and comfort in this spacious updated 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath condo townhouse, perfectly situated in the vibrant heart of downtown Stamford. Freshly painted and featuring new luxury vinyl plank flooring, this spacious second-floor unit is move-in-ready. Enjoy abundant natural light in the open concept living and dining area with fireplace and elegant plantation shutters. Step out onto your private balcony, ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Both bedrooms are large with en-suite bathrooms and generous closets. Laundry is also on the second floor. The building includes elevator access for easy living, an assigned parking space in the garage and is just minutes away from Stamford's top restaurants, shops, parks, and Metro-North station. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a stylish and centrally located home in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods!
